product.name: AI Voice Agents
product.description: Cloud-based AI systems that handle inbound and outbound calls using natural language processing to automate customer interactions in multiple languages, including Arabic dialects.

product.name: AI Call Management Solutions
product.description: Automated call handling solutions that manage call routing, scheduling, and customer query resolution using AI voice agents integrated with CRM systems.

product.description: Tiered subscription plans providing varying levels of AI voice agent usage, concurrency, and integration features tailored to business size and call volume.
